sum: Motor & General Finance Limited disclosed receipt of a substantial acquisition of shares notice under SEBI Regulation 31(4), signalling a change-of-control event requiring public disclosure by the acquirer.
detail: The Motor & General Finance Limited submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to NSE. This notice is mandatory when a person acquires 5% or more in a listed company and intends further acquisition. The company's sector classification as Financial Services (likely non-bank finance) places it within SEBI's takeover supervision scope. Specific acquirer details, shareholding percentage, and consideration amount are contained in the full regulation 31(4) statement not excerpted in the Bar & Bench article.
